purpose: Fleet-wide umbrella and standalone trigger for the complete FP, MTM, SCF, AEX, and SEAL contract.

narrow_terms.AEX: Cross-cycle adaptation only; AEX remains the narrow evolution loop.

trigger.standalone_means: Execute and account for the complete five-phase contract.
trigger.not_applicable_rule: Allowed only when the phase activation predicate is demonstrably false; cite the evidence.
trigger.unknown_rule: Missing, stale, mismatched, exceptional, or unverifiable evidence is UNKNOWN and fails closed.

task_adaptation.rule: A profile changes phase depth, evidence classes, and tool budgets only; it never expands user authority.

goal_identity.semantic_hash: sha256 of canonical UTF-8 JSON with sorted keys and compact separators

complexity_budget.over_budget_rule: Evidence-backed justification is mandatory; otherwise convergence fails.

transaction_contract.interruption_rule: A transaction not COMMITTED or RECOVERED is UNKNOWN and fails closed.

evidence_contract.retention: bounded by producer policy or janitor
evidence_contract.live_state_rule: stale evidence cannot support a live-state claim

machine_validation.aex_activation: Only a verified comparable cross-cycle residual activates AEX.

self_check.purpose: FAMES run against FAMES. Each case states its expectation before it runs (FP), costs one in-process call and zero model tokens (MTM), its failure count IS the residual (SCF), a non-zero dimension is the only thing that activates a change (AEX), and the written record cites package_sha and replays (SEAL).

fail_modes.closed: blocks; the run is not ok
fail_modes.degraded: counted into the residual and reported, but does not block

self_check.unknown_rule: UNKNOWN blocks regardless of the declared fail_mode, including an unknown case kind, residual dimension, or fail mode. Data cannot introduce behaviour.
self_check.extension_rule: Adding a check means adding a case to the SSOT, not writing code. Cases are evaluated in-process by declared kind; no case may name a command to execute.
self_check.honesty_rule: A real residual stays red until it is fixed. Silencing or deleting a case to make a run green is a contract violation, not a fix.

SCF.activation: A verified result exists for the current goal identity.

AEX.activation: A verified comparable cross-cycle residual remains.

freshness.rule: FAMES is resolved at run time from disk, never from the contract text already sitting in a thread's context.
freshness.generation_stamp: SKILL.md carries a FAMES-GEN line; the runtime command reports the on-disk value.
freshness.stale_context_rule: A FAMES-GEN in context that differs from the on-disk skill_gen means the held copy is stale: re-read SKILL.md and the bundled protocols from disk, and treat any phase already judged with the stale copy as UNKNOWN.
freshness.parity_rule: Bundled protocols must match the registry SSOT by version and by line-ending-normalized content; drift is UNKNOWN and fails closed. A machine with no registry is a legitimate cold load and reports NOT_APPLICABLE.
applies_to: threads opened before the contract changed
threads opened after the contract changed

architecture_standard.retention_rule: Every file and process requires a verified caller or contract role; otherwise merge or remove it.

self_convergence.principle: A package that needs an external engine to update itself is not portable. The runner is part of the package: converge = follow + heartbeat + rider report, and arm registers the runner on the machine's own clock.
self_convergence.degraded_path: Where the arming engine is absent, arm prints the exact registration proposal and reports a named blocker instead of claiming a rider it did not create.
self_convergence.disarm_respected: --arm repairs a drifted registration but never re-adds a rider an operator removed.

convergence.proof: local receipt and GitHub contributor manifest package_sha equal authority package_sha

natural_events.boot: HubClock autostart makes the in-package fames-converge rider eligible at the next 15 minute wall-clock boundary
natural_events.github_change: authority manifest_sha or package_sha delta triggers verified atomic activation
natural_events.local_skill_change: content fingerprint delta publishes the node contributor manifest
natural_events.network_recovery: the next HubClock boundary retries after an unreachable GitHub event

convergence.online_lag_bound: 15m after HubClock is healthy and GitHub is reachable

cognitive_operator_layer.purpose: A provider-neutral reasoning quality layer for task completion, debugging, architecture, foresight and resource allocation. The labels name operations, never personality diagnoses or evidence.
cognitive_operator_layer.phase_relationship: Runs inside task execution between MTM routing and SCF comparison; it does not alter FP -> MTM -> SCF -> AEX -> SEAL.
cognitive_operator_layer.selection_rule: Choose the smallest pipeline matching the task class. Do not invoke every operator by habit.

Ni.operation: Converge heterogeneous evidence into one coherent, falsifiable model and expose the next discriminating test.
Ni.failure_mode: premature convergence that hides alternatives or treats a narrative as a fact

Te.operation: Measure or change external state, then read it back against Verification.
Te.failure_mode: claiming completion because the work is understood, discussed or written while external state is unchanged

Ne.operation: Generate alternative routes, counterexamples and unobserved failure branches that can change the current ranking.
Ne.failure_mode: unbounded ideation that consumes resources without changing a decision

Ti.operation: Formalize candidates as invariants, contracts and a bounded counterexample search.
Ti.failure_mode: internally elegant analysis with no falsifiable contract or stopping budget

trace_contract.prediction_rule: A forward branch is a hypothesis until Te installs a probe or guard and measured evidence resolves it.
trace_contract.unknown_rule: An unknown task class, missing operator, wrong order, unmet stop condition or unreadable policy is UNKNOWN or FAIL and cannot seal.

meticulousness_and_efficiency.purpose: Measure early risk, accounting conservation, loop escape, mutation bounds, negative interactions, leading indicators, representation fit, inverse diagnosis, and epistemic admissibility without treating cognitive labels as personality science.
meticulousness_and_efficiency.unknown_rule: Undefined units, malformed types, missing fields, stale series, exceptions, and unknown mechanisms are UNKNOWN and fail closed.

stability_margin.rule: PASS is current only; a near boundary or rapidly shrinking measured margin is warning, while an undefined unit is UNKNOWN.

conservation_ledger.rule: Each transition accounts for costs, evidence, authority, and an explicit residual; authority and evidence cannot expand without measured input.

loop_escape.rule: Three consecutive attempts with no external or discriminating delta require an escape action; productive repetitions remain valid.

grip_guard.activation: R2 or R3 mutation after internal analysis
grip_guard.rule: High-impact mutation requires a bounded transaction, rollback and read-back, or a measured emergency recovery drill.

destructive_interference.rule: Every new capability must retain a passing caller-backed core probe before and after installation.

bifurcation_foresight.rule: Before crossing, output is forecast/hypothesis; after a measured crossing it is a measured conclusion; stale series is UNKNOWN.

basis_alignment.rule: Use replayable measured units and reject a selected representation dominated by a cheaper compatible route; unitless aggregate scores are forbidden.

inverse_diagnosis.status: engineering supplement; not an original-theory claim

epistemic_layers.rule: Tone never promotes a claim; SEAL accepts only the evidence class required by the goal.

external_learning.purpose: Governs information acquired from OUTSIDE the fleet that proposes an improvement to the fleet. Turns 'I read something useful' into work with the same completion truth as any other FAMES work.
external_learning.lane_rule: This is a lane that feeds AEX, not a sixth phase. execution_order is unchanged. A promoted candidate is an adaptation and is judged by AEX, SCF and SEAL like any other adaptation.
external_learning.activation_predicate: material originating outside the fleet is used to justify a change to fleet canon, tooling or routing

owns: retrieval of bits from a channel
ACQUIRE.cost_rule: route order is cost order: publisher-supplied text (0 quota) -> local model (0 quota, material never leaves the machine) -> metered API
ACQUIRE.authority_rule: A login wall, paywall, bot check or rate block is a named blocker reported to the operator, never a puzzle to solve. Acquisition never creates an account and never enters a credential.

UNDERSTAND.capability_rule: A stage declares a capability (asr.*, vision.*, text.*), never a vendor; the vendor is a data-driven junction chosen by scheduling and rotation.
UNDERSTAND.separation_rule: The model supplies language, not facts. A fact is measured by a deterministic instrument or it is not a fact.

owns: what the source asserts, attributed to the source
CLAIM.rule: A source assertion is recorded as a claim with its trust class and its own wording bounded to the minimum needed to test it. Restating a claim never promotes it to fact.

owns: a bounded local test of the claim against this fleet
TRIAL.rule: The trial's Verification is written before the trial runs, exactly as in FP. A claim that cannot be given a Verification is rejected as untestable, not adopted on plausibility.
TRIAL.already_covered_rule: Before trialling, check whether existing canon already implements the claim; already_covered is a first-class verdict and costs nothing.

PROMOTE.gate: authority node only, after FP, SCF and SEAL — the same gate as fleet_topology.peer_learning; followers may publish an ingest record as candidate_improvement but must not promote it.

trust_classes.measured: produced by a deterministic local instrument (ffprobe duration, sha256, exit status, HTTP status). Admissible as fact.
trust_classes.modelled: produced by a model reading the material (ASR, OCR, translation, summary). Admissible as a rendering of the source, never as a fact about the world.
trust_classes.asserted: the source's own statement. Admissible only as a claim attributed to that source.

external_learning.admissibility_rule: Only measured items may be cited as SEAL evidence. A modelled or asserted item enters as a candidate and requires a measured verification of its own before any phase may go PASS on it.

record.unknown_rule: A record missing provenance, content identity, route or a per-claim verdict is UNKNOWN and fails closed; UNKNOWN never promotes.

non_goals: retaining material the source licenses against

distribution.unknown_rule: A missing receipt, stale carrier manifest, unreadable bundle, or package hash mismatch is UNKNOWN and fails closed.
distribution.event_runner: in-package HubClock rider fames-converge -> scripts/fames_fleet.py converge (self-contained; no hub engine on the update path)
distribution.event_runner_legacy: hub-only convenience path: fleet-skill-pulse -> fleet-skill-sync-tick.py -> mtm-fleet-skill-github.py tick. Publishes contributor manifests; not required for a follower to update.
distribution.no_change_cost: one authority manifest fetch for followers; package files are not fetched when verified package_sha already matches
